lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Abonnieren\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
2 uses of the private API of the server in 2 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

lib/ reads the clock directly in 1 place. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
Nothing in the app calls 2 OCS routes. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
The app has 2 OCS routes and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
